The Intelligence Graph operates as a typed primitives layer atop existing schema, collapsing disparate data sources into unified composite read models. GameIntelligenceNode aggregates signals from Pick, PickSignalSnapshot, and GameSignal, producing a coherent game state vector with confidence-weighted metrics. SlateWeather aggregates daily context into a density-based weather model, enabling strategic inference across slates. CreatorAsset maps these insights into structured narratives, ensuring consistency and compliance. Trust gates are enforced at the composition layer, preventing downstream consumers from bypassing integrity checks. Failure modes include null edgeIndex due to insufficient data, or refusal in ModelCourtCase when evidence health is low. The system avoids external dependencies, relying solely on database inputs for deterministic behavior.
